title: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (Redeem in-Store) @ NBL
body:
Deal: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (Redeem in-Store) @ NBL

[M00Cow] so is there a forum where someone, post the code words?
[new2onlineshopping] Anybody who wants the direct link so you can easily claim vouchers on multiple accounts, send me a DM. I posted it as a deal but it was deleted as a duplicate because Jollystacker got in with the codeword first. 👏😂👏
[tunzafun001] Need to open in incognito with browser first?
Or just let it go straight to the app?
[new2onlineshopping] I paste the link in an incognito window, then when prompted, leave the browser so it opens up in the HJ app.
But remember to log into a HJ account that has NOT had the free cheeseburger thus round before you try the link.
It did take about 20 seconds for me before the voucher appeared in the Rewards section (I was constantly refreshing).
[tunzafun001] Worked…. When I opened rewards it popped up. Cheers.
When is the last day to claim (tomorrow, to be used my Monday?)
[new2onlineshopping] @tunzafun001: Yes, if you click the link after lunch tomorrow (but before 6pm), you should get a voucher that expires on Monday. But again, only for a different HJ account that has NOT had the free cheeseburger this round.
[Tommohalby] I get the email but when claiming it opens the app but it is not there.. Anyone else get this?
[TrafalgarSean] I had to open the app, then click the link, then it opens the app and nothing happens for a minute then it adds it.
[Big-Deal] Why is it expiring tonight when it should be by end of gameweek? I see 2 games tomorrow
[Jollystacker] not sure i just saw that it said must enter code by midnight tonight
[GnarlyKnuckles] Yeah, I think maybe you can get the burger any timer up until midnight tomozza, as long as you enter the code before midnight tonight? Not sure though …
[GnarlyKnuckles] Thanks you posters, for your efforts. I'm pretty sure the NBL is subsidising this whole thing, and will do well out of it, so HJs is not 'losing' anything. So … 'party on Garth' :)
It's got to be said, that this year HJs has streaked so far ahead of Maccas that it's hard to comprehend why Maccas is not doing some sort of damage control. Maccas' latest effort (month of … crap) was an epic fail, yet we have HJs doing stuff like this promo, 'back-to-back weekends', plus other genuinely cheap promos now and then throughout the year. Then there's the 'shake-N-win'; which is often a handy add-on to an order, if you are going there anyway. Maccas has never had anything like that (well, 'Monopoly' I guess, but while that used to be good, it is now just used to market other brands/products/services most peeps have no interest in). It's as though Maccas has given up even trying to compete with HJs.
Big ups to you HJs, you are playing the game well.
In other news, apparently a bunch of new fast food chains are about to 'set up shop' in Oz. That should make for interesting times!
